description: A regional form of a species, expressed as a DELTA against the base species record (#40). Only changed fields are listed; everything else inherits. Composition with lustre (#15): variant first, lustre second — a lustre map is per-form data, authored against the form's own palette; a base-form map is never applied to a regional form.

baseSpeciesId.description: Core species id this is a form of.

delta.description: Only what changes. Any field absent here is inherited, not unknown.

growthPath.description: Evolution edge ids (#8) where this form's line differs from the base line; null = same line.

habitatShift.description: Spawn-table area ids (#7) this form is met in.

silhouetteDetailNotes.description: Detail-level changes only (crest, tuft, marking placement). The silhouette PRIMITIVE may not change — see 'unchanged'.

types.description: This form's element pairing, where it differs (element vocabulary per species template, TBD D6).

identityReference.description: Likeness for identity is scored against the BASE species' model sheet; the form's own approved art is its currency reference thereafter.

region.description: Region the form belongs to. Region 1 is the home form and takes no variant record.

status.description: Provenance: 'canon: <source>' / 'provisional' / 'OPEN'. No instance ships as canon until the owner locks it.

unchanged.description: Explicit inheritance list — what a variant may NOT change. Stated so a variant cannot drift into a new species by accretion.

variantId.description: <speciesId>--<regionTag> (double hyphen per the bundle variant-parsing convention, #15).

title: Mochiichao regional variant (form delta)
